commit_subject: fix(sync): jobs or boards moved before the first sync (offline, signed out, a failed sync) keep their places instead of taking the cloud's order (RES-R2-140-a)
commit_body:
Cause: an order carries no updatedAt, so collectionSyncPlan.planFirstSync always put the cloud's order first. A move is sent by a flush only once a first sync has run, so one made offline, on a page loaded signed out, before a failed sync was retried, or within the pause before a sign-out, was lost to the cloud's order at the next first sync.

Fix: a three-way merge on a recorded base. The sync record (collectionSyncMeta.js) keeps `order`, the ids in the order the account's cloud holds as last seen here; firstSync writes the order it leaves in the cloud and a flush that sent an order records it (noteVersions). planFirstSync takes `baseOrder`: when the cloud's order is still the base's (compared on the ids both have, so an item added or deleted elsewhere is no move) and this browser's is not, this browser's order leads and what only the cloud has goes right after the id before it in the cloud's order; otherwise the cloud's order leads, as before. leaveList keeps a move not yet sent aside for the account (its order and base), and the next first sync lets it lead the same way. A record saved before the order was kept reads with none (null), and its first sync lets the cloud's order lead, as it did: no storage-version bump. forgetSynced forgets the order with the versions. docs/knowledge/05-state-auth-sync.md says so.

Test: tests/unit/collection-sync-order.unit.mjs — jobs moved offline, on a page loaded signed out, and kept aside at sign-out keep their order and send it; a job another device added keeps its place beside a move made here; moved on both sides, the cloud's order wins; boards moved while the cloud refused a flush keep their order after the retry; an old record without an order still reads; forgetSynced drops the order; planFirstSync's order cases. All fail without the src change.
notes: Confirmed at d11d5a0: planFirstSync built ids as [...order (cloud), ...local ids] (collectionSyncPlan.js:71-73), and changed() queues nothing until a first sync has run (engine :252), so a move made before it never reached the cloud. Product calls made: (1) moved on both sides, the cloud's order wins (the device that sent first) — no per-item order merge; (2) the 'is the cloud's order still the base' and 'did this browser move' checks compare relative order on the ids both lists have, so an item added or deleted on another device does not count as a move there, and one added offline here does not count as a move here; (3) when this browser's order leads, an item only the cloud has is woven in right after the id before it in the cloud's order (first when none), so another device's new item keeps its place; (4) a move not yet sent at sign-out is stashed per account (stashed[uid].order/base) as unsent edits are; (5) forgetSynced (damaged saved list) also forgets the order so the cloud's order leads. No DATA_VERSION bump: the record lives under its own key and a missing/non-array `order` reads as null (old behaviour). Existing tests traced by hand against the change (job-sync offline test, board order test, sign-out stash tests, delete-edited order assertion): unchanged outcomes. Tests were not run (owner's rule).
